desc:
Sew stunning dresses! 🧵👗✨ from the first measurement to the final stitch, then show them off in your very own shop! 
Cut, pin and sew your designs, and dress your clients in something truly one of a kind.

📏 Measure your clients so every piece fits just right!
🎀 Pick from over 400 fabrics: silk, velvet, lace, sequins and more!
✂️ Cut out your pattern, pin it on the dress form and sew it together!
🏠 Run your own cozy shop and put your best designs on display!
👑 Take commissions, earn prestige and become the top dressmaker!

USE CODE : "RELEASE" for  500 Crowns!

Find more about Dressmaker's Dream by joining our Group!

Inspired by Dressmaker
